topic: Myth: miners can approve any transactions they like
title: Myth: Can Bitcoin Miners Approve Anything?
hook: Can a miner just add any transaction they want?

scenes.narration: Some people think whoever mines a block decides what is valid. That is not how Bitcoin works.
Each full node independently validates blocks using the same consensus rules.
Nodes accept a block only if all its transactions are valid and not already spent.

cta: More mining basics are waiting, and the link is in the description.
description_body: Miners propose blocks, but full nodes validate them. A block with invalid or already-spent transactions is not accepted.
